messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P0 — Multi-region failover detected. Automatic failover attempted from us-west-2 -> us-east-1. Symptoms: sustained 5xx spike, increased p95 latency, and partial traffic stuck in stale routecache entries. PagerDuty: PD#12345.

maya: I'm on it, getting logs and checking healthchecks. paging oncall.

raj: seeing ~18% 5xx in us-west-2 API GW (errors: downstream connection reset). Backend pods in us-west show high conn errors to user-db replicas.

eva: DNS lookups OK from our external probes, but internal routecache has entries still pointing to drained AZ subnets. suspect control-plane route propagation lag.

liam: starting incremental traffic shift to us-east-1 to reduce load on us-west. will do 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics look good.

maya: copy. sam, can you confirm replication lag on user-db replicas in us-east? we don't want to shift if write replication is behind.

sam: replication lag is nominal (~200ms). reads should be safe. writes look fine for a short window.

raj: pushing DR runbook step 2 now. listing commands:
```
# drain nodes in us-west AZ-a
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/api-gw
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/api-gw --replicas=0 --selector=az=us-west-az-a
```
Will do once we confirm route change.

maya: noted. eva, can you flush routecache and force re-eval on edge routers?

eva: issuing routecache flush on all edge routers in us-west-2 now. command: `edgectl flush-cache --region us-west-2 --force`

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder — maya handing off to raj in 15m unless resolved.

maya: brief impact summary for support: some customers in EU experienced increased errors (~10-20%) between 02:10-02:25 while traffic was partially routed via failed AZ. sending to julie-cs to baseline affected customers.

julie-cs: thanks, will notify top 20 customers via status page and set "degraded performance". Drafting message now. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-12345

liam: shifting DNS failover weights now: Route53 weighted records updated 10%->50% over 5m. watching p50/p95 and 5xx.

maya: metrics look stable at 50% shift, 5xx trending down to baseline in last 2m. continue to 100% if no regressions.

raj: starting full 100% shift. also flipping autoscaling policy to add 2x capacity in us-east just in case.

sam: DB health good after shift, replication caught up. no stalled transactions seen.

eva: post-flush sanity: edge routecache entries cleared, new sessions resolving to us-east endpoints.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Traffic shift complete. Failover to us-east-1 at 02:29 UTC. Auto rollback/tracking disabled while manual postmortem created.

maya: starting incident timeline + notes. paging followups: confirm why routecache didn't expire sooner and why control-plane propagation lagged.

raj: I'll own mitigation writeup and immediate action items (drain automation, routecache TTL tuning).

sam: adding DB action item: add replication lag alert threshold to trigger earlier in failovers.

julie-cs: customer comms sent: "Degraded performance in US West resolved — full failover completed. We're investigating root cause; no data loss observed."

maya: handing off final oncall to raj. oncall-bot: please hand over PD#12345 to raj and create follow-up ticket in #postmortems. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff complete. PD#12345 assigned to raj. Created postmortem ticket PM-9876 in backlog.

raj: closing thread for live mitigation. saving logs and metrics. will open RCA draft in #postmortems by EOD.
